name: che-ical-mcp
description: Native EventKit integration for macOS Calendar and Reminders apps
long_description: A powerful MCP server providing 29 tools for managing macOS Calendar events and Reminders. Features include attendee/organizer read-only access, per-event timezone support, undo/redo, flexible date parsing, fuzzy calendar matching, batch operations with dry-run preview, advanced filtering/sorting/limiting, conflict detection, duplicate finding, multi-keyword search, recurring event occurrence-level operations, MCP-level #hashtag tags for reminders, and support for iCloud, Google, and Exchange calendars. Requires macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all available calendars and reminder lists

tools.name: create_calendar
tools.description: Create a new calendar or reminder list

tools.name: delete_calendar
tools.description: Delete a calendar by its identifier

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range with optional detail_level, fields, display_timezone, filtering, sorting, and limiting

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event with optional reminders, recurrence, structured location, and per-event timezone

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event (including timezone, recurrence span for recurring) (annotated destructive: updates can replace or clear existing values; an update that touches a recurring event cannot be undone)

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event (with occurrence support for recurring)

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List reminders with structured recurrence rules, due-date precision, start date and time-based alarms (minutes_before: positive = before the due date, negative = after)

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a new reminder with optional due date, recurrence, location trigger, and tags

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Update an existing reminder (including tags, clear_due_date; changing due_date also moves the start date and absolute-date alarms, realign_to_due puts them onto the due date, date_sync reports whether they agree) (annotated destructive: updates can replace or clear existing values)

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Complete or reopen a reminder with an explicit operation result and observed next occurrence (annotated destructive: completing a recurring reminder consumes an occurrence irreversibly)

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search events by keyword(s) with AND/OR matching, optional detail_level, fields, display_timezone, and limit

tools.name: list_events_quick
tools.description: List events with quick time range shortcuts (today, tomorrow, this_week, etc.) with optional detail_level, fields, display_timezone, and limit

tools.name: create_events_batch
tools.description: Create multiple events at once

tools.name: check_conflicts
tools.description: Check for overlapping events in a time range with attendees/organizer

tools.name: copy_event
tools.description: Copy an event (new identifier; recurrence and attendees not copied); with delete_original it moves the event like move_events_batch and refuses recurring events

tools.name: move_events_batch
tools.description: Move events between calendars in place (keeps recurrence, attendees and the identifier within an account); span this/all for recurring events; reports method and fields not carried over; recorded for undo

tools.name: delete_events_batch
tools.description: Delete multiple events at once

tools.name: find_duplicate_events
tools.description: Find duplicate events across calendars

tools.name: update_calendar
tools.description: Update a calendar's properties (rename or change color) (annotated destructive: updates can replace or clear existing values)

tools.name: search_reminders
tools.description: Search reminders by keyword(s) or tag with AND/OR matching, structured recurrence metadata, start date and time-based alarms (minutes_before: positive = before the due date, negative = after)

tools.name: create_reminders_batch
tools.description: Create multiple reminders at once (with tags support)

tools.name: delete_reminders_batch
tools.description: Delete multiple reminders at once (one undo recreates them from the undo snapshot)

tools.name: list_reminder_tags
tools.description: List all unique tags used across reminders with usage counts

tools.name: cleanup_completed_reminders
tools.description: Delete all completed reminders in one call (dry_run=true by default). Optional calendar_name / calendar_source to scope to a single list. Each call is one undo entry and clears the redo history; one undo recreates the deleted reminders, one at a time, from the undo snapshot.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last operation (refused without writing when the item was changed since; the record stays until the change is reverted or the user discards it; also refused when a reminder's recorded list is not found, and discarding a delete_reminder undo loses the deleted reminder; updates to recurring events are never undone; a delete of an occurrence and the following ones is undone only when it started at the series' first occurrence and removed it all; a deleted occurrence comes back as a one-off event), or explicitly discard the current top history record using discard_id from undo_history

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone operation (only completions are written again; for any other record redo writes nothing, answers success: false with the tool to use, and that entry is removed from the redo history; a completion redo is refused when the reminder changed since the undo)

tools.name: undo_history
tools.description: List undoable operations with stable record IDs, timestamps and undo/redo counts
